class: Sanitized diagnostic exports hide locally needed failure evidence
symptom: SmartRecruiters stop PNGs contain a full-document mask and all 150 runtime messages omit details; dropdown structure dump is empty. Saved page snapshots show invalid compensation and Gender fields but do not establish the selection failure cause.
root_cause: The conservative export privacy policy was also the only screenshot/log capture policy for owner-authorized local diagnosis.
why_tests_missed: Tests verified exclusion of private data but had no explicit opt-in local evidence path.
fix: Add independent LOCAL_DEBUG_CAPTURE copies with secret filtering under Git-ignored local_debug; preserve the existing sanitized export pipeline and do not change safety.py.
prevention: Keep owner-authorized local debugging and safe-to-share exports separate; test both evidence usefulness and secret filtering. This fixes evidence capture, not the unverified original dropdown incident.
